3214485.steps:
1. Enable authentication partitioning.
  2. Configure a parent partition and at least one sub-partition. Do not set any RADIUS Accounting clients in the sub-partition.
  3. Pull a TSR, or on CLI type "show tech-support-report user-authentication-partitioning". It hangs and after a short time warnings of high CPU and semaphore long hold times start getting printed on the console.
3214485.initial: Firewall shouldn't freeze/reboot dwhile downloading TSR or CLI type "show tech-support-report user-authentication-partitioning"
3214485.title: GEN8-5730: Printing a TSR can get into an infinite loop when authentication is enabled

1519595.steps:

1519590.steps:

1519586.steps:

  3. Click on Add button again and this time select Partition type as "A sub-partition" select Parent Partition.
  4. Observe the result.
1519586.initial: 1. sub-parition added successfully and display under specified parent partition by an arrow marked.
1519586.title: Add sub-partitions under specified partition
